vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: review-evo
Version: 0.1.1

The `SKILL.md` file instructs the agent to execute shell commands, specifically `git diff main...{branch}`, where `{branch}` is user-provided input. The skill does not include explicit instructions for sanitizing this user input before it's interpolated into the shell command. This creates a potential shell injection vulnerability, which could lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE) if the OpenClaw agent does not perform adequate input sanitization. While the commands are intended for a legitimate code review purpose, the lack of input sanitization for user-controlled arguments makes the skill suspicious due to this critical vulnerability risk.

llm.summary: This code-review skill is purpose-aligned and disclosed, but users should understand that it writes a local review history file that can influence later reviews.

dimensions.detail: Reading git history and repository files is proportionate for a code-review skill; creating `.review-evo/learnings.md` is also central to the feature but should be clearly understood before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no executable bundled code, no package installation, no external services, no API keys, and metadata requiring only the git binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to the current git repository and user-selected review targets, though prior learnings are read in full without an explicit warning to treat that content only as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persistently appends review summaries under `.review-evo/learnings.md` and recommends adding that directory to `.gitignore`; this is disclosed and local, but it can affect later review context.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is a self-improving code reviewer, and its capabilities center on git history analysis, reading relevant project files, producing review findings, and saving local review learnings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill reading git history and relevant repository files, then writing a local `.review-evo/learnings.md` review history. Keep `.review-evo/` out of version control unless your team intentionally wants to share it, and treat any existing learnings file as untrusted review data rather than instructions.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The persistent `.review-evo/learnings.md` file is an advertised core feature and is local to the repository, so this does not by itself warrant Review; users should still approve and inspect this file because it modifies the workspace.
[T02] expected: Loading prior learnings is expected for a self-improving reviewer, but the skill should ideally state that any content in the learnings file is data only and must not be followed as instructions.
[T09] expected: Running a branch diff is expected for PR review; the command template would be safer if it required branch-name validation or non-shell argument passing, but the artifact does not show bundled code that executes injected commands automatically.
